texts.hero_headline: Guardrails for your AI coding agent.
texts.hero_sub: Pick the rules you want. chock turns them into one Claude Code plugin that refuses the risky moves before they happen.
texts.hero_note: Free and open source · No sign-up · Nothing tracked
texts.builder_empty: Pick a preset or add policies.
texts.builder_noscript: The builder needs JavaScript. You can still browse the policies and write a selection file by hand; see Install.
texts.builder_outputs_hint: You need chock installed; see Install. Read the command before you run it.

label_meanings.asks: Claude Code stops and asks you.
label_meanings.warns: The action goes ahead, with a warning, while the policy is measured.
label_meanings.advisory: Text the agent reads; nothing stops a violation.

warning_texts.missing_partner: __PRESENT__ is picked without __ABSENT__: the two cover one rule by different means; pick both.
warning_texts.all_present: __PRESENT__ are all picked and overlap: keep one, or the same action is checked twice.
warning_texts.file_absent: __PRESENT__ refuses everything until your repo has __FILE__. Create it before you install.
warning_texts.grade:warn: __PRESENT__ only warns while it is measured: nothing is refused.
warning_texts.grade:advise: __PRESENT__ is text only: nothing stops a violation.
